style: purple/black problem-friction brand piece; League Gothic display + Montserrat labels; confident positive hook flips into stark muted negative reveal, then bold payoff line. Continuous accumulating flow — every scene transition crossfades (next scene begins entering before the prior scene finishes exiting) so no frame is ever blank on the alpha-overlay export.

customize.note: No catalog block matched an abstract storefront motif or a positive-checkmark/negative-X comparison closely enough (searched 'storefront building silhouette outline' and 'checklist positive to negative reveal crossed out x mark' via npx hyperframes catalog — nearest hits were generic icon-morph/outline-draw/grid-card-assemble primitives, not this specific pairing). Hand-authored per builder-contract, reusing the established purple-brand CSS custom properties, check-row/check-mark list pattern, and lane/card layout rhythm already proven in sibling projects shared-lead-problem/index.html and speed-wins-the-job/index.html: same :root palette vars (--bg #0D0817, --bg2 #1B1130, --accent #9B5CFF, --accent-bright #C9A8FF, --text #F3EFFA, --muted #9088A8, --negative #B5675C), same font stack, same full-bleed #bg-fill persistent background, same back.out/power-eased entrance vocabulary, and the same overlapping-clip crossfade technique (next scene's data-start begins before the previous scene's data-start+data-duration ends) used there to avoid any blank alpha frame.

scenes.motion: scale_punch/slam entrance on a beat at 0.1s, brief hold, then fade+lift exit starting 2.1s that crossfades under the positive-list scene
